items.summary_en: At least 30 people have been killed after a mound of rubbish at a major waste site collapsed onto nearby homes in Guinea's capital Conakry, the government said. Another 22 people were injured in the city's Dar-es-Salam area, and significant resources including the military have been deployed to search for survivors after the collapse followed heavy overnight rain. There are fears the death toll will rise further, as another landslide at the site killed 10 people in 2017.
items.title_zh: 幾內亞垃圾掩埋場崩塌，至少30人喪生
items.summary_zh: 幾內亞政府表示，首都柯那克里一處大型垃圾場的垃圾山崩塌，掩埋鄰近民宅，造成至少30人死亡。市內 Dar-es-Salam 區另有22人受傷，崩塌發生於徹夜大雨之後，當局已投入包括軍方在內的大量人力搜救生還者。外界擔憂死亡人數將進一步攀升，該場址2017年也曾發生山崩，造成10人罹難。

items.title_en: Hugging Face reportedly exploring sale at $13 billion valuation
items.summary_en: AI model repository Hugging Face is reportedly exploring a sale that could value the company at $13 billion or more, and has hired a bank to sound out potential buyers, according to Business Insider. The talks are at an early stage and no bidder has been named. The startup was last valued at $4.5 billion in 2023, and a deal would land amid a run on AI distribution assets, days after Stripe agreed to acquire OpenRouter for a reported $7.5 billion.
items.title_zh: 傳 Hugging Face 尋求出售，估值上看130億美元
items.summary_zh: 據《Business Insider》報導，AI 模型平台 Hugging Face 正探索出售，估值上看130億美元，並已聘請銀行探詢潛在買家。相關談判仍處於早期階段，目前沒有具名的競購者。這家新創2023年的估值為45億美元；就在 Stripe 同意以傳聞中的75億美元收購 OpenRouter 的數天後，此交易將落在 AI 通路資產的收購熱潮之中。

items.title_en: Lanier wins world title as Taiwan's Lee and Yang claim doubles bronze
items.summary_en: Alex Lanier became the first singles badminton player from France to clinch the BWF World Championships title, beating Japan's Kodai Naraoka 21-11, 21-11 in a lop-sided men's final in New Delhi. Taiwan's Lee Jhe-huei and Yang Po-hsuan fell 21-18, 21-14 to China's Liang Weikeng and Wang Chang in the men's doubles semi-finals, taking a bronze that matched Taiwan's best-ever result in the event. In the women's final, South Korea's world No. 1 An Se-young beat Japan's Akane Yamaguchi 21-17, 21-14 for her second world crown.
items.title_zh: 拉尼爾奪世錦賽金牌，台灣李哲輝與楊博軒收下男雙銅牌
items.summary_zh: 法國的拉尼爾在新德里的男單決賽中以21比11、21比11直落二擊敗日本的奈良岡功大，成為法國史上第一位羽球單打世界冠軍。台灣組合李哲輝與楊博軒在男雙四強以18比21、14比21不敵中國的梁偉鏗與王昶，收下銅牌，追平台灣男雙在世錦賽的最佳成績。女單決賽方面，南韓世界球后安洗瑩以21比17、21比14擊敗日本的山口茜，拿下個人第二座世界冠軍。
